final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT dist.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as count FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id GROUP BY dist.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count FROM region_counts), region_shares AS (SELECT rc.region, rc.count, rc.count * 1.0 / t.total_count as share FROM region_counts rc, total t), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM region_shares rs, avg_share_calc asc WHERE rs.share > asc.avg_share
